title: Warm Fluffy Malaysian Rice Pilaf
description: A citrusy and comforting Malaysian dish featuring vegan butter and kombu-cold-extract, perfect for a cozy meal.
instructions: Rinse the jasmine rice in a fine mesh strainer until the water runs clear.
In a large saucepan, melt the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the orange zest and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rinsed rice to the saucepan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the kombu-cold-extract, orange juice, low-sodium soy sauce, and salt-free seasoning blend to the saucepan.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the pilaf rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
